These measurement results are an important check point to validate the design of the SAGA system. The background light and atmosphere metrology activity has the following objectives : - Design and procure test setups for measuring the background light (sky background and artificial light pollution) of the sky in urban environments. - Design and procure test setups for measuring the atmospheric turbulence conditions at urban environment.- Executing a measurement campaign at differenturban environments (at least 10 distributed over Europe) at different times (covering varying weather conditions, time of the day and different seasons). - Analyzing the data and assessing the impact on the QKD key rate.
